verdict.rationale: Gitea's self-hosted nature (docs-9, docs-10, docs-13) implicitly gives an operator full control over where data lives and how long it persists, and repo/issue management docs (docs-1) imply basic deletion capabilities, but there is no explicit documentation of retention policies, data purge/export tooling, or GDPR-style deletion guarantees. Community feedback (gitea-comm-19) even flags a lack of a good backup/restore mechanism, undercutting confidence in data lifecycle control. Missing for 10: explicit retention/deletion policy docs, data export/purge APIs, audit logging for deletion, and independent confirmation that deletion is reliable.
